blocks.text: If by “generate it” you mean obtaining the Stack XML, the supplied evidence says to download the Stack XML needed for the Software Update Manager (SUM), push the selected software packages to the Download Basket, and download them with the Download Manager. It does not specify the subsequent SUM steps, such as exactly where to place the files or which SUM screen to use.

The evidence also says that, starting with SUM 2.0 SP 10, only a kernel for the target database needs to be selected; an up-to-date SAP Host Agent and SUM can also be selected. However, it does not establish whether those selections apply to your particular update.
